title: dbclear
summary: Clear RunMat debugger breakpoint status entries.
behaviors: `dbclear all`, `dbclear in file`, `dbclear in file at location`, and `dbclear if condition` command text is accepted.
RunMat does not yet implement execution breakpoints or `dbstop`, so clearing the current empty registry is a no-op.
`dbclear` is a sink and returns no output.

faqs.question: Does `dbclear` remove active execution breakpoints?
faqs.answer: RunMat does not yet have active execution breakpoints. The command is accepted and clears the currently empty registry.

gpu_behavior: `dbclear` is host-side debugger state and has no GPU/provider behavior.
